added_lines: Keysight researchers have been recognized with the Best Demo/Poster Award at IEEE CSCN 2026 in London. The winning demonstration, “Hardware-in-the-Loop Phase-Aware CNN for Real-Time 5G Channel Estimation,” was developed through a collaboration between Keysight AI Labs in Barcelona and the CSG team in Málaga, showcasing a lightweight phase-aware CNN validated in real time through hardware-in-the-loop testing.
